senses.gloss: uyate, pass. to Skt. vā, weave (cf. ūyate, B.S. in Wh. Roots), is woven, in uyamāna-(pres. pple.)-vardhanam Mvy 〔8410〕 (so Mironov and v.l. Kyoto ed. for text upamāna-), magnification of (a robe that is) being woven (for oneself), a sin for a monk; Tib. ḥthag pa (weave) (b)skyed pa (make increase). The short u is supported by Skt. uta (beside ūta), ppp.
